Built into every protein you have, it carries the small hook where your body switches a protein on or off, one of the commonest switches in you. Beyond the building, it sets how your cells take light in and turn it into something you can use.

This substance is not this energy's alone. Three others in you share it; together the four unlock time and light. Here it is light brought to one point. A fine enough beam goes through anything, and that is what your focus is doing in you when it lands.

keywords: At Ease in Your Own Skin

fields.essence: This energy is being yourself: at ease in your own skin, walking your own way, and it shows in how you move. Nobody is being performed for. You do the thing the way you do it, and nothing about it is heavy: a person walking as themselves has a lightness in the step that a performed walk never has.
fields.glance:
This energy is being yourself: at ease in your own skin, walking your own way, and it shows in how you move. Nobody is being performed for. You do the thing the way you do it, and nothing about it is heavy: a person walking as themselves has a lightness in the step that a performed walk never has.

Real ease has nothing to defend, because you have stopped holding a position on yourself. Easy is right, and those three words are the whole of it. Most people do not do easy: the harder you struggle the more you feel you exist, so the easy way is the one you pass every morning. What you do with ease has play in it, and people relax near it, because someone at home in themselves gives everyone else leave to be at home too.

Let the looking run down. There will be days when you cannot stop watching yourself, checking how you are coming across before you have said a word, and the checking is what stiffens the step. The easy road is there, seats along it, friends along it, and most people turn back from it because it asks so little. Walk the way you walk.
fields.iching:
You are walking close to something that could hurt you: someone with power over you, or a moment with teeth in it. You will come through, and how you carry yourself while you are near it is the whole of the matter. Nothing here is won by being stronger than the strong thing. The tiger does not bite because there is no fear in the step, only a plain gladness at walking, and gladness provokes nothing.

What it asks is that you tell high from low and keep to your own place in it. Do not provoke what is bigger than you, and do not shrink from it either, because both are ways of watching it instead of walking. Say what is yours to say and no more. Keep your steps light, and want only what is already yours. This is the ground a life is built on, the way you behave when nobody is making you, and it either holds or it does not.

In the body the sky is the head and the lake is the mouth. Notice where you are holding yourself now: the head up and clear, the mouth easy, the weight not yet on the foot that is down. Walk as yourself, walk lightly, and the way that is dangerous becomes the way through. Heaven over Lake: the whole of the sky, with a stretch of open water lying still and glad beneath it. Its creature is the tiger, whose tail you have stepped on, and the tiger does not bite. The old character shows a body with its repeating steps, one word for the path and for the way a person walks it. Treading
fields.gene_keys:
Self-Obsession Naturalness Being Being what you already are, with nothing put on, is the ease this energy is made for. You do the thing the way you do it, and the doing has play in it, the way a child draws. You are not your name, or your feelings, or anything else a label could be put on. Once that is felt the tightness around the question goes out of the body, and what was tied up in the search comes back as energy. Your edges soften. There is nothing to defend, because you have stopped holding a position on yourself. What you make from here is new, because it is copied from nobody. If it is playful it is yours. If you have heard it somewhere before, it is not.

This cannot be practised or copied. The moment being natural becomes a method it is the watching again in a new coat. Nothing you feel is unnatural, the laziness or the pain, and seeing that is what softens you. Softer, more open, more yielding: that is the whole of the way, and it has no path. Attention turned in on yourself, and stuck there, is where this energy starts. You walk into a room and the room is about you: how you are coming across, who you even are. Most of the time it hides in busyness: the hours filled with work or errands, the resting put off until Friday, until the holidays. At the end a life has gone by. Underneath is a fear of losing yourself, and the fear sends you looking. Who am I is the question. The search for an answer becomes a maze with plenty of drama in it and no way out, because the one thing the search makes sure of is that you never have to face yourself. As long as you are looking at yourself you cannot see anyone else, and everyone you look at becomes someone you would like to change.

Nothing here needs judging or fixing. See the pattern and add nothing to it. The search wears out on its own once it is seen, because what it was hunting was never a thing that could be found. What is left when it stops is you, unwatched. There is nothing to find here and no one looking for it. The question that started everything is gone, the way a thing you were carrying is gone once you set it down. Life has no hidden meaning left in it, and it is beautiful, one moment turning into the next. There is laughter in this, because from here the whole search looks like a joke everyone is in on. It is so ordinary you would not spot it in a room. If you stayed near it long enough, the one thing you would notice is how unrested you are.

This is what ease becomes when even the one being easy lets go. There has never been anything to do, because there is no one to do it, and so everything gets done. It is the plainest state there is.
fields.human_design:
The Behaviour of the Self The pressure here is on behaviour: that what you do should match who you are, down to the small acts nobody sees. Gate 10 is the door it comes through, and its other name is self-love, because the two turn out to be one thing. When you are at home in yourself the people near you relax and are freed to be at home in theirs. When you are not, it is unbearable, and the pressure turns outward into blame, or into a hard word that cuts. In you it runs as a refusal to act a part: you would rather be disliked as yourself than liked as someone else. Putting something on feels like a lie in the body.

From outside this can look like self-absorption, and sometimes it is, because a self being lived out loud takes a great deal of attention. People who carry this all their lives learn to tell the attention that keeps behaviour honest from the attention that only watches. They tell them apart by how the body feels while it does each.
fields.tarot: The family here is six, and between them they tell the one story every human life tells. The Mysteries Play is the wound you start with. Inner Light Symphony is the fight with your own shadows. Pearl of Christos and Beyond Binary are the mind's limits and the need to control, both given up. Internal Treasure is the finding of your own nature. The Thunder of Your Giving is the waking that comes after. Open any to see where in the story you stand. A foot on the tiger's tail, and five faces watching the step.
fields.body:
This energy lives in the heart, and the reason is the beat. Nothing tells your heart how to beat. A patch of cells in its own wall sets the pace, and a heart cut from every nerve, as a transplanted heart is, goes on beating. The nerves only lean on it, faster or slower. It is the one part of you that behaves entirely as itself, which is what being yourself is from inside, a thing that was already going. The heart is the sovereign of the body, ruling by being in place rather than by doing. Your presence lives there, the thing in a face that tells you someone is home.

It sits behind the breastbone, left of the middle. Lay a hand flat there, or two fingers at the side of your neck, and wait for it. When you feel watched the beat picks up, and that is all the watching ever gets to do here: hurry it. It was going before you noticed, and it goes on after you stop. Being yourself has a chemistry in you, and the substance is arginine. It is one of the twenty small pieces every part of you is built from, and one your body makes for itself. Once you are grown you do not have to eat it. When you were a child your body could not make enough of it, and took the rest in from meat or a handful of nuts. Everything this energy is kin to shares the one substance, a single chemistry for the whole family, most of which is about the heart, about what happens when it is trusted. So ease is not added to you from outside. It is there inside you already, the moment you stop arguing with your life. Its substance was made in your own body, on its own, without a thought from you.

keywords: The Light Was in the Dark

fields.essence: This energy is peace: the hour when what rises meets what settles, and everything between them grows. In you it lives as pictures. They come faster than one life could ever act on them, each whole with all its parts at once. Among them is a picture of how things could be, set so high that no realist would put their name to it. That picture is what lights you. When it is alive in you the day has a direction, it gets you out of bed with something to do, and every choice begins to arrange itself around it.
fields.glance:
This energy is peace: the hour when what rises meets what settles, and everything between them grows. In you it lives as pictures. They come faster than one life could ever act on them, each whole with all its parts at once. Among them is a picture of how things could be, set so high that no realist would put their name to it. That picture is what lights you. When it is alive in you the day has a direction, it gets you out of bed with something to do, and every choice begins to arrange itself around it.

You hold the picture loosely. It is not a plan to be built as drawn; it is what draws you upward. You cannot know what it will become as it comes into the world, only the feeling it stirs in you. Believe in the dream and give up what it looks like. Give it something to land in, a shape, a table it can be worked at, because a picture with nothing to land in stays a picture. Not every one that comes through you is yours to make. Most are for other people, and your part is to hold them clear until the one they are for arrives.

There are stretches when a haze settles between you and the world, when the pull is to read it as needing more: another teacher, a better account of how it all works. The light is behind the cloud, and the cloud is made of the pictures you have been pushing out of sight because they would not line up into sense. Let them come as they are, without asking them to mean something first, so the haze thins on its own. What you were looking for was already in you, waiting to be let out.
fields.iching:
You are in a good season, and it is a season, not a place. What was small in you is leaving, what is large arriving: the habit of adapting to whatever came along has less hold each day, and an aim you chose for yourself has room to grow. It is the first month of spring, with half a year of growing ahead, and it came because you walked the last stretch carefully. Things that would not meet are meeting: what you hoped for with what is there, the people above you with the people below.

The good season asks that you work inside it rather than rest in it. There is no flat ground without a slope coming, no going without a return, so the hour will pass. It lasts longer for the one who braces it: who spends what they have to keep the meeting open, who bears with what is rough and unfinished, who does not forget the ones far off or close the circle round a few. There is a time to make peace by strength and a time to keep it by yielding; this is the second.

The belly settled down over the head is this energy in the body, the soft front of you placed above the thinking. Let the belly lead, the head under it, and the meeting holds a while longer. Earth over Heaven: the ground on top, the sky underneath, the wrong way round, and that is the point. What always rises is placed below, so it rises into what always settles, and the two meet in the middle instead of drawing apart. The traditional character shows a person standing in water, joined to what holds them up. Peace
fields.gene_keys:
Obscurity Idealism Light Trust the stream of pictures that is already yours and the fog begins to thin, not because you understood it but because you stopped demanding that it make sense before it could move. What opens is idealism, and not the soft thing the word has come to mean. You set a picture of how things could be so high that no realist would sign it, heaven on earth, the world made whole, and you do not believe it is literal. You let it organise you. Every choice begins to arrange itself around it, and it warms you from within long before any of it shows.

The craft is in the holding. You commit to the dream and give up what it will look like, because a picture coming into form never arrives as it appeared in your head. A castle you were shown turns out to be a way of working you could not have named. Grip the appearance and the flow chokes. Play with it, as with a story you know is a story, so it keeps moving. What you have to give was never the picture. It is your heart, open enough to catch other people alight. A haze can settle between you and what is in front of you, so that you look at your beliefs about a thing, calling it sight. That haze is obscurity. It loves a system: a teacher, a method, anything that promises to lift the fog without your having to walk into it. The relief is real but short, because the new belief sits where the old one sat, between you and the thing. A method is a raft, for crossing, then for leaving on the far bank. Most people read the dimness as needing more, so they pile it on, and the pile is the problem.

What is in the cloud is the stream of pictures that comes up from the side of you that does not think in words, pushed out of sight because it would not make sense. Left there it turns into private fantasy and hidden wishes. The pictures you avoid most come back to find you, often wearing the face of the person you love. The fog is not the wall. It is the door, and it asks only that you not understand it yet. One point of light in a dark sky is a single moment of pure awareness, a pause where thought stops. Then there is another, then another, until the sky of a life is more light than dark and the dark patches crack open from inside. That is what the pictures become when the last of them fuse into one, and the one is faced: a clear light behind every form, showing through it, not the light the eye sees, with no one left standing outside it. You find it only by going down into the dark, which is why the ones who carry it seem to lead people away from the light, deeper into their own murk. From here nothing is hidden and no one can pretend. Good and evil stop being the way the world is sorted; it comes back the way a child first met it, with the light showing through everything.
fields.human_design:
Ideas Ideas arrive in you as a pressure, and Gate 11 is the door they come through: more of them than one life could ever act on, with the urge to sort the flood into order. It feels like standing under a waterfall with a cup. The cup is real. The waterfall was never yours to bottle. Not every idea that comes through you is yours to act on. Most are for other people, and the skill is knowing the few that are, then guarding those, because others will take them to sell.

From outside, a person carrying this can look dreamy, all talk. What is going on is the labour of being a place where an idea can land and be kept until the one it is for turns up. The cost is a particular panic: that each idea must be seized, forced into the world, or it is lost. That panic wears a person down until they no longer trust their own timing. With years of this you learn to ask one question of any idea, what if, and then to let it go until it is wanted.
fields.tarot: Within the Codon Ring of Light, this code stands as the meeting itself, heaven and earth mingling into clarity. Its siblings, UL 5, UL 9, and UL 26, carry the rest of the family: the waiting that trusts time, the small steady focus, the great force held back until its hour. Four codes bound by one amino acid, all of them ways the world is connected to light. By way of the codon ring this card carries one Arcana, the Star, the quiet light after the storm. The two trigrams each give their own faces: Earth above as the Devil and the World, the binding and the completion; Heaven below as the Fool and the Empress, the open leap and the fertile ground. What they spell out between them is a force rising into a field that receives it, crossing into form.
fields.body:
The pituitary is the gland in you that sends word, and the reason this energy lives there is that a picture in you has to reach the rest of you. It is the size of a pea, sitting deep behind the bridge of your nose. Nearly everything it releases is a message to another gland: the one that sets your pace, the ones that make a child. It does none of your work itself. It tells the parts of you that do, and the whole body answers. That is what a picture does in you. It is seen behind the eyes, and it changes the body from there.

The nerves from your two eyes meet and cross just above it, so what you look at passes over it before it becomes seeing. Put a finger to the bridge of your nose: the crossing is straight back from there, deep in the head, with the gland hanging under it. How tall you grew was decided there, while you slept. The seeing in you has a substance, and the substance is threonine. Nothing in you makes it; it arrives in milk or cheese, or not at all. Three kin in you share it, and what the four do together is set how your body takes in light to make it something it can use. Yours is the part that concerns light in the mind: the eye, and the way an image made of light becomes, further back in the head, a thing you imagine. When there is a haze over what you see, that is where it sits, between the light and how you read it. Much of what you eat of it goes to renew the slippery lining that runs the length of you inside, a coat no light ever reaches.

fields.essence: A pure heart is the energy here, with the sense that comes with one, which tells the real from the fake by what your heart does when each is put in front of you. A thing made from the heart lands one way in you, a thing faking it lands another, before you have a word for either. What you cannot fall in love with, you do not trust. It lives most of all in the voice, where what you meant is heard under the words you chose. You can pick the most beautiful words there are, and the tone under them will still tell what you meant. It comes with a guard, built early, which is what most people meet before they meet the heart.
fields.glance:
A pure heart is the energy here, with the sense that comes with one, which tells the real from the fake by what your heart does when each is put in front of you. A thing made from the heart lands one way in you, a thing faking it lands another, before you have a word for either. What you cannot fall in love with, you do not trust. It lives most of all in the voice, where what you meant is heard under the words you chose. You can pick the most beautiful words there are, and the tone under them will still tell what you meant. It comes with a guard, built early, which is what most people meet before they meet the heart.

You get the truest work from this sense by pointing it at yourself first. The same honesty that sees through everyone else is pointed at your own holding back, at where you keep people out, at why. What it finds there is a fear that someone could take what is clean in you. Nobody can. What is clean in you is out of everyone's reach, so the flood you have spent a life keeping out can be let in, the feelings, the wounds of other people, all of it. It turns out not to drown you. Feelings rise, then they fall again, and what is left when they have fallen is that you remember what love is like. The aloneness you were looking for was never aloneness. It was this, your own heart clean, depending on nothing outside you.

Letting people in is slow, a refining that goes on for the whole of a life. The heart opens the way a flower does, a petal at a time, each one let go as the fear behind it proves false. Stretches come when you have let no one in for a while and cannot say why. The shut is not coldness. Behind it is someone who loves more than they will admit, waiting for it to be safe, and it was never unsafe. The last of the guard goes late, all at once.
fields.iching:
Nothing is getting through. What you say does not land, what you do goes nowhere, and the people who should be meeting you have turned away, each to their own side. This is a season, the seventh month, when the growing has finished and the decline has not shown yet. None of it is your doing. The small are coming forward while the worthy step back, and however unfair that is, it is what such a time is like.

Do not force the way open, because no force opens it. Draw in. Spend little, of money and of yourself. Refuse the pay and the honours a blocked time offers, since they go to the wrong people now. Keep to your own kind, the ones who go quiet with you, and let the rest go on without you for a while. Hold your own worth inside, where nobody can see it. Do not let the wrongness of what is happening rot the thing in you that is still clean. It is your turn to move and there is nowhere to move to; that is the whole of it. It is a season, so it ends.

The head and the belly are this energy in the body, the head above, the belly below, each keeping to itself with nothing passing between them. Feel for it now: the face in order, the belly gone quiet under it. Let the head come down a little, and wait the way the ground waits. Heaven over Earth: the sky above and the ground beneath, each in the place that looks right for it. Each is moving away from the other, the sky rising, the ground sinking, so that nothing passes between them. The traditional character is a bird up in the sky that will not come down, with an open mouth between its wings, saying no. Standstill
fields.gene_keys:
Vanity Discrimination Purity A fake reaches you as a discomfort before any reason for it: someone pretending, or a thing made with no soul in it. The sense is done by feeling, and it cannot be argued away. The same sense tells you what is good for you, what to eat, who to keep. It makes you a critic people are a little afraid of, one who cannot be taken in by anyone selling a dream. It sets you apart, because it will not stay near compromise. It turns into art, the work that carries a feeling across to another person whole.

What it is for is love, the human kind, with all its drama and its danger. The people who carry it are moved by feeling all their lives, and they are here to pass it on. Enter the drama unafraid and let it run through you. In time you stop watching love from the side and become it. The voice that comes from that place stirs whoever hears it. There is a part of you that believes it is on its own, and loves that. It is not pride, which needs an audience. This is quieter, hiding in what you feel or leave unsaid, and the finer you become the finer it becomes. Under it is one fear, that another person could take away your freedom, reach in and remove something. So you are careful with your heart. People are let in now and then, in small measured amounts, then they leave wanting more. You go on looking for more room and never find enough. The mind is sharp, always able to find the reason the other person falls short. On the surface you hold it together. Underneath, the feeling runs hotter than you let on, and being loved can be the most frightening thing of all.

You cannot think your way out of it, because even the thought that you are getting over it is more of the same. Know that it is there, and leave it. As long as you feel yourself to be separate it keeps pace with you. It lets go late, all at once, of its own accord. Purity is a heart with nothing on it, and everyone has one under everything else. The self you were once fell in love with itself; here, what is highest in you falls in love with you, and the two turn out to be one love with the separation gone. Nothing can touch it. Lock such a person up and their love goes on. Even the worst of people has this at the centre, so there is no evil, only thicker and thinner layers over it.

To arrive here you give up everything you gained, the whole climb, and you come out like a child, still human, with a voice past words. Most who live it live the plainest of lives, unseen, passing quietly, reminding whoever meets them that this exists in a human form. Its colour is white beyond white. The moment you see anything as bad, it is gone.
fields.human_design:
Caution Saying what you feel, and not before its time, is the pressure this energy puts on the body. It enters at Gate 12: the drive to put a feeling into words, held back by a fine sense of when the words would land and when they would not. You speak when you are moved to, not because a silence needs filling. You take longer than most to answer, because the answer has to come up from what you feel before it is true. When the words come easily, the time is right. When they will not form, that is not failure; it is the signal to wait. Forced out early, they fall flat and leave you doubting them.

From outside the waiting looks like shyness, or like being hard to reach, and people who like speed will say so. The cost is that when you are overwhelmed you go silent, and the silence gets read as coldness. A lifetime of this teaches that the shyness was never a weakness, only the timing. A word said at its hour weighs more than a hundred said before it.
fields.tarot: This code stands almost alone. It holds a ring of its own, the Ring of Secrets, a single card nested inside the larger Ring of Trials it shares with UL 33 and UL 56. Those three are the genetic stop signals, the three great tests on the road to oneself, and this one is the last of them. What the ring guards stays locked until the highest frequency turns the key. A secret sits at the middle of this card's Arcana. The ring gives one, the High Priestess, keeper of what is hidden. The two trigrams each give their own faces: Heaven above as the Fool and the Empress, the open beginning and the fullness that nourishes; Earth below as the Devil and the World, the binding attachment and the finished whole. A beginning that has not spoken, a silence that keeps its reason, and at the far end a whole that already contains it.
fields.body:
Swallowing is the reason this energy is given to the throat. Every time you swallow, the voice box lifts, a small flap folds down over it, and the two folds inside it shut. Your breath stops, for about a second, while what you swallowed goes past behind. It happens several hundred times a day, and every time everything in you stands still so that one thing can pass. That is this energy in your flesh. A baby can breathe while it feeds; you lost that when your voice box came down to where words are made, which is the price of speech. When you laugh or cry, the pattern of your breath changes, and your chemistry with it.

Put a finger on the ridge at the front of your throat and swallow. It rises under your finger, and for that second no breath comes. The ridge under your finger is the Adam's apple, named for the man who swallowed what he should not have and never got it down, a mind caught on its own words. Your body has no substance that answers to this energy. Nearly everything you are made of is written in small words, each naming one piece, read one after another. Three of the words you are written in name nothing, and this is one of them. Where your body reads it, nothing more is added, and what was being made is let go, whole. In you that is the passage from one state to a higher one, in which your tie to your own past is ended, so that you come out permanently changed. It ends your separate existence too, and the sense of being separate goes with it: crossing your own throat, you are swallowed by life.

Two others in you carry the same stop, and of the three this is the last, the innermost. Each of the three can bring you to a halt.

keywords: The One People Tell Things To

fields.essence: Listening is the energy here, the part of you that people tell things to. Hearing is done with the ears. This is done with everything you are, and it needs time, with a little distance, to work. People feel it and set things down in front of you, the secret, the old hurt, because something in you can hold what is said without needing to answer it. It lives wherever two people are more than the words passing between them.
fields.glance:
Listening is the energy here, the part of you that people tell things to. Hearing is done with the ears. This is done with everything you are, and it needs time, with a little distance, to work. People feel it and set things down in front of you, the secret, the old hurt, because something in you can hold what is said without needing to answer it. It lives wherever two people are more than the words passing between them.

You are the first person it listens to. You hear your own heart before your mind starts talking, because the mind is not wrong, only early. While someone is still talking you catch your own reply forming underneath, set it down, and go on listening. What you hear then is the note under the note, the thing a person means and cannot say. They feel it as trust before they know why, and trust spreads outward from the one who can take things in. Listening asks nothing of anyone, which is why it is the one power that changes people without pushing them.

The past is where this energy does its work. What you lived through is still in you, and what you never finished hearing returns, in a new face each time, until you do. There are seasons when all you can hear is the bad news, and it feels like seeing clearly. It is only the oldest part of you, listening for danger alone, and it can be heard too. Listened to all the way through, the old story loosens its hold, and the past you were locked in becomes the one you learned from.
fields.iching:
You are among people who are not your own, gathered in the open with one fire between you, and the question is what will hold you together. Not blood, because the open country is far from the family house, and not habit, because none of you has been here before. What holds a circle like this is an aim everyone faces, with a fire in the middle to see each other by. It asks this first: see each person for what they are before you draw them in. A fellowship is a fire that tells one kind from another, then warms them both.

Keep your own motive out of it. A circle gathered for someone's private gain breaks at the first strain. One gathered for a purpose none of them own can cross the great river. There is always one soft place in the middle of such a company, the person everyone wants beside them, and the circle holds as long as that person is not claimed by any one side. Help the others toward what they want and you will find your own aim reached on the way. Never let a friend walk alone at night.

In the body this energy is the eyes. Notice where your gaze is now: on the one you are with, or past them at the fire. Look at each face as it is, unhurried, and keep your hands open. What holds a company together is that each of them was seen. Heaven over Fire: the open sky, and under it a fire that rises toward it. Fire climbs and the sky goes on, so the two move one way. The traditional character sets a cover over a mouth, the silent understanding of two who fit without a word, beside the sign for people. A fire in the open, with people gathered to it, all facing one way. Fellowship
fields.gene_keys:
Discord Discernment Empathy Discernment begins when you turn and listen to yourself. The feelings are still running, the wants still course through the body, but now there is someone watching them go by, and that someone is not swept down with them. You start to see how much of your view of other people was your own mood, and your agenda comes into the light, where it can be set down. From there the ear opens. You catch your own reply forming under someone's words and let it wait. You hear the note under the note, what a person means and cannot say. Because you heard it, they trust you before they know why.

Then the past changes. What looked like a run of accidents shows a pattern, the same few stories every life is telling, the ones every people has told as tales by a fire. You are living one, and seeing that brings a hope that is not cheap: it is felt in the belly, not decided in the head. Listen to the heart first, which is silence, then let the mind speak. The deeper you listen, the more of what you hear is love. Discord is what listening becomes when it hears only one band. Something older than thought in you is tuned to danger. On the days it has the ear, the whole world comes through as bad news, one crisis after another, proof that people cannot be trusted. It does not feel like an opinion. It feels like being realistic, and every generation says it in the same words, that things were simpler once, that people cared more. The good news arrives too. You hear it and cannot believe it. How could so many be wrong, and you be right?

Under the heaviness is distrust, one person of another, and under that a distrust of life itself, as if its story were bound to end badly. A life has a shape the way a story has, and the shape does not run downhill. This is not a choice you made. It is too much noise in the head, too many layers over the heart. The day you stop arguing with the heaviness and let it say what it has been saying, it begins to move. What you had forgotten, under the noise, was love. Empathy is being inside another, not beside them. Sympathy needs two. This needs one, and the one is not you. For that the separate self has to go, which is why thirteen was always feared as the number of death: it is a death, of the one who was listening. What remains is the listening itself, so total that it takes in everything, a panther, a stranger, from the inside. There was a fear to cross first, the cold of feeling cut off from everything alive. It was crossed by going all the way into it.

To sit with a person who has come here is to be healed by being heard. Every fear you have comes to the surface and is loved until it is gone. The past opens in you so wide that you are no longer a point but a place, with every creature in it, and from there the future can be seen.
fields.human_design:
Narrative The pull that makes people tell you things is this energy in the body. Gate 13 is the door it comes through: the drive to take in what has been lived, yours and other people's, then keep it until it means something. Strangers feel it before you have said a word. They sit down beside you and out comes the secret, the story they have carried for years, because something in you holds what is said without needing to fix it. You did not ask to be told. You were told anyway.

The cost is weight. Stories that were set down in you stay there, and a person who keeps everyone's past can end up living in it, retelling the old hurt until it is who they are. The drive can also go quiet about itself: so much room made for other people's stories that there is none left for your own. What the drive is for is the retelling. The past you keep is not fixed. The story you tell of it sets the direction your life faces, and it can be told again, truer, on any day you choose.
fields.tarot: This code sits in the Ring of Purification with UL 30. The two purify through fire. This one is the listener, the one who takes the whole of the past in and digests it clean; the other is the blaze of desire that has to burn through before it clarifies. Discord becoming empathy, raw wanting becoming rapture. A small family, bound by what it must dissolve. The Devil carries the weight of these five arcana. The Ring of Purification gives the Devil, the face of attachment and the bondage that has to be seen before it loosens. The two trigrams give their own faces: Heaven above as the Fool and the Empress, the open beginning and the abundance it ripens into; Fire below as the Emperor and the Sun, the clear sovereign seeing and the bright joy at the center. So the card leaves a question standing: does this fellowship warm what it gathers, or hold it?
fields.body:
The amygdala is the organ your body gives this energy, and the reason is the flinch. The amygdala is two knots of nerve cells the size of an almond, one deep in each side of your head. It hears first: a rough copy of every sound and sight reaches it a fraction of a second before the thinking part of you has the whole. It keeps each memory with the feeling that came with it, so a voice or a smell that once came with hurt is stored with the hurt still on. A likeness sets the heart going before you know why. Someone speaks, and something in you has already answered. The listening this energy is made of begins there, where you watch that answer instead of obeying it.

The next time a sudden sound makes you jump, notice the order: the jump, then the knowing what it was. Put a fingertip just in front of the opening of your ear. A few centimetres straight in is the part of you that heard first. The heaviness you hear on a bad day is in your body as well as your ear, and it holds only as long as you believe it. It has a chemistry in you, and the substance of it is glutamine. Your body makes it, in the muscle, and bread is full of it. There is more of it loose in your blood than of any other.

Where it goes first is your gut. The cells that line your gut burn it before anything else, taking it from the blood as it passes. The gut is where the great sorting is done: what feeds you is drawn out, the rest is let go. Listening, in your body, is the same sorting. What you take in, from a day or from a person, is kept or released down there, below thought. That is how purifying it is when you listen.

keywords: Giving In a Little at a Time

fields.essence: Plenty is the energy here, and with it the drive to work at what you love. You were born with more than one life can use: a way of doing things that is yours alone, an appetite to work at it, and a store meant to be spent on that work. When the three are together the days have heat in them, your hands know the next move before you have thought it, and what you make feeds more people than you.
fields.glance:
Plenty is the energy here, and with it the drive to work at what you love. You were born with more than one life can use: a way of doing things that is yours alone, an appetite to work at it, and a store meant to be spent on that work. When the three are together the days have heat in them, your hands know the next move before you have thought it, and what you make feeds more people than you.

This work runs on love, never on proof. You do the work in your own manner, you learn what you do not know, and you are not made smaller by help. It cannot be done in hiding, because the heat of it spreads. Give some of what you have before you are sure you can spare it. What is given makes room, and the room fills.

What thins this energy is a small giving in, the kind nobody would call a choice, and after enough of them the plenty is gone without anyone having taken it. The way back is to spend what is left on something you would do for love, however small, and watch the level come back up. Work is the shape this energy takes in a life, and the work you love is the only kind that keeps it.
fields.iching:
You have a great deal, and the season is good. The sun is high, nothing is hidden, and the strength under you has not tired. None of it was luck; it is the harvest of what you have been, and now you stand beside a full load wondering what a full load is for.

The danger here is fullness, not loss. A cup filled to the brim spills at the first step. Once you are full of what you have you begin to believe you made it alone, which is the short road to the one who thinks they have what they have not. What holds all this strength in place is one soft opening at the top, a place in you that is modest and can be reached, which the strong parts answer to without being made to. Keep that opening. Stop what is harmful in yourself before it gets on board, let the good in you show, and give the best of the harvest upward, to whatever is larger than your own house. The one who cannot do that is owned by the load.

In the body this energy is the eye, the part of you that sees in full light what belongs and what does not. Sort what you are holding. The posture for this hour is the one who has much and can still be reached: open at the top, firm underneath, in step with the season. Keep the load moving; it was loaded to be carried out, not kept. Fire over Heaven: the sun at the top of the sky, and under it the whole strength of heaven. Everything is lit, everything is supplied, and none of it is fastened to you. In the name, great is a figure standing with arms and legs thrown wide; having is a hand reaching for the moon, held the way the moon is held, for a night then gone. Great Possession
fields.gene_keys:
Compromise Competence Bounteousness Competence is what working looks like on someone who loves the work. Stop the inner surrenders, one small act a day, and the wagon starts to roll, slowly, at its own pace, picking up speed every day it is not standing. The work goes low, into the belly, and from there it finds the simplest way through anything, the way a saw drawn toward you cuts finer for less effort than one shoved away. It has a manner that is only yours, and it is loose enough to take on a job it has never done, then learn it.

You cannot do it in hiding. The heat of it spreads the way the leak used to, only outward: it turns a few people into a team and draws the right help toward a wagon that is moving. If you would rather work alone, dig a little, and what you find is usually fear of your own size, dressed as modesty. Get clear on what you want to serve, take months over it if you must, then put your shoulder to the wheel and push. Everyone has a wagon, and yours was loaded before you were born. Almost nobody drives off with it. The load is let go one small surrender at a time, each too small to look like a decision. The kind that costs you is the inner kind. Staying home because someone you love is unwell costs nothing, since love made that choice. Taking the job that pays over the one that pulls costs you every time, and so does letting the thing you wanted as a child slide a little further off each year. The tell is the same every time: you do not feel good, something low down contracts, and the wagon, still standing in the yard, begins to leak from underneath.

Compromise is catching, and it hides in sensible words, being realistic, being a team player. The contraction is a better guide than the words. It only happens because the load is still there to lose, and one act a day that does not sell it is enough to feel the leak stop. Gratitude is where this ends, and it began as an ember. Out of nothing, a spark the size of a seed, cupped in two hands and breathed on until it caught. Fed, the ember becomes a steady flame, the flame a fire, the fire a sun, and the sun gives because giving is what it is. Whoever was driving the wagon is gone. There is only the unloading, with a strange arithmetic under it: the more goes out, the more arrives, and the more arrives, the more there is to be thankful for.

Nothing in this takes. Receiving is still here, and receiving is a different thing; it feeds the thanks. What you have in great measure turns out to mean fertility, plenty moving through one body into other lives with nobody managing it. Think of a person like that and something in your own week loosens. One life lived this way pulls everyone a little way toward plenty.
fields.human_design:
Power Skills Through this lens, plenty is a surge low in the body: get up, get working, make more than you need, turn it into something others can live on. Gate 14 is the door it comes through, the drive to generate resources in the plainest sense, money and material. What it generates them for is only partly you. It pulses. High for a stretch, then gone, and on the high days you can outwork anyone in the room while on the gone days you cannot say where it went.

From outside this gets called things: greedy, or someone who cannot switch off. From inside it is a pressure to produce that will not leave you alone, and it turns sour only when it has nothing worth producing for. Aimed at something you love it is stamina. Aimed at nothing it is restlessness, which is the same power with no road.
fields.tarot: Here the spark from UL 1, Earth's Breath, has been fed and has something to burn, and what it throws off is a harvest. Two cards only in this ring, one fire at two moments. Over there is the wanting to make, the flame that starts from nothing and asks for nothing. Here is the making carried all the way out to a loaded wagon and handed round. That card starts things. This one is what starting was for. The loaded wagon under the noon sun is dealt five faces here, one from the ring and two from each trigram. The ring gives Temperance, pouring from one cup into another without spilling a drop. A full load has to learn that. Fire above gives the Sun and the Emperor, the plain radiance and the seat it rules from. Heaven below gives the Fool and the Empress, the open first step and the ground that makes it fruitful. Read in order, that is trust, fruit, rule, and the pouring out.
fields.body:
Every meal you have ever eaten became you in one place, the small intestine, and the reason this energy lives there is the meal itself. It is several metres of tube folded under your navel, made to receive what is plentiful and turn it into what the rest of you can use. Its wall is folded, the folds covered in fingers, so that inside a tube you could close a hand around is a surface the size of a room's floor. Nearly everything that feeds you crosses it. It keeps nothing of yours: what crosses goes into your blood, what cannot cross is passed on down, and even its own lining is made new every few days.

Put an ear to a belly, your own if you lie quiet, and what you hear is liquid moving along this tube. Between meals, every ninety minutes, a slow wave sweeps it clean, and the growl you have called hunger is mostly that wave. You are listening to the part of you that is loaded every day and keeps none of it. The fire you work from has a chemistry in you, and the chemistry is lysine. It is built into every protein your body makes. You cannot make it; it comes in from meat or beans. Grain alone leaves you short of it, which is why a bowl of rice wants beans beside it. What you are good at was in you as a spark at birth, and a spark has to be fanned into action, by a childhood if you were lucky, by you if not.

From lysine your body also makes the carrier that brings stored fat out to be burned, so on a long walk with the meal hours behind you, what you are running on was carried there by it. That is the fire with something to feed: what you took in weeks ago, spent now, on the road.

fields.essence: What is worth most in you keeps itself low. Something in you is larger than the life around it, and it lives in that life anyway, at ground level, without once saying how large it is. Nobody has to be told. Real size does not know it is real, which is how you can tell it from the other kind. It lives in ordinary days, the same street, the same people, and makes them the place where everything that matters happens.
fields.glance:
What is worth most in you keeps itself low. Something in you is larger than the life around it, and it lives in that life anyway, at ground level, without once saying how large it is. Nobody has to be told. Real size does not know it is real, which is how you can tell it from the other kind. It lives in ordinary days, the same street, the same people, and makes them the place where everything that matters happens.

A life of ordinary days is the arena it chooses. The trials that count are not out at the edges of a life but in the middle of it, at the sink or with the ones you live beside, and you never need to walk out of your own door to meet them. A grey morning is part of this. Two people can stand in the same one, one of them in heaven, the other in hell, with the morning the same for both. What you make of a day runs underneath the mind and the mood, deciding which world you live in.

Slowing down is how this is carried. Living things have never hurried; the nearer you come to their pace the more you draw, until people come toward you without knowing why. Some days go grey with nothing wrong in them, and the dread underneath is of every day being this one. Let the grey in rather than outrun it. What looked like the life going out of you turns out, at the bottom, to be full.
fields.iching:
You have something real, ability or plain size, and the situation asks you to carry it low. Not smaller, low: the work done in full and the credit let go, the thing finished before anyone knows who finished it. Of all the shapes a life can take, this is the one in which every step turns out well, from the bottom to the top, and the old readers found that nowhere else. It is done in company, with the people around you treated as your equals and the plain work shared. What is full gets resented, and what is kept low gets helped.

Weighing is what it asks of you. Where there is too much, take some away; where there is too little, add to it; keep the load level across everyone, yourself included. Then carry it through, because beginning was never the hard part and finishing is. Do not mistake the low carriage for softness: when what you hold is threatened, hold it, fairly and without heat. Refinement is not in your clothes. It is in the light in your eyes, and in how people feel about themselves after an hour with you.

The hand carries this energy in the body. Look at what your hands are doing now, open or closed, and what they are holding. A mountain inside the earth does its work the way a hand does, without needing to be looked at. Hold yourself level, as a field is level, with the weight underneath and nothing of it on show. Earth over Mountain: a mountain standing inside the ground, the highest thing in the country held under a level field where none of its height shows. What is largest here is underneath, and what is on top is plain. The old character sets words beside uniting, what is said kept close to what is so. Modesty
fields.gene_keys:
Dullness Magnetism Florescence Slowed down, this energy becomes a pull. The earth has a pulse, far under the pace you live at, and your body is tuned to it. The more you come down to that beat, the more you draw, none of it on purpose. This is not charisma, which is life force spilling over the surface of a person. This works from below the surface, may never show in the personality at all, and is felt in a room as something around a person that nobody can name. The ground was never in a hurry: leave a city alone for a thousand years and it is forest again.

Come down to that pace and what you feared was draining the life out of you turns out to be its source, an empty vessel found full. The ones who carry this are close to green things, and to people at the whole width of the range, the drab as much as the bright, because they can find something in anyone worth loving. Loving everyone means being able to feel what a person is, whether or not you like them. The grey of the low is the colour here. A grey day, with nothing wrong in it, is the whole of this low. The colour has gone out of things, the food is food, the work gets done, and under it runs the dread of the same day tomorrow, then the one after, without end. That dread is the fear of an ordinary life. Rage is not dull, grief is not dull; dullness is the dead middle, where there is no charge either way, and every low state has this at its core. It comes with the weather: on a clouded morning something in the body changes, in everyone, and the dullness is in how you read the change.

Stuck in the mind, you reach for something to fill it. Stuck in the feelings, you sink, and the body's energy sinks with you. Neither works; no technique does. What works is letting the grey all the way in: the further it goes, the less dull it is, until at some depth it is not empty at all. A dog can sit on a step for a month and never be bored. Only a person can be dull, because only a person takes a view of the day. Flowering is what this becomes when the seeking stops, not one flower but a whole tree breaking into bud at once, in every direction, faster than a mind can follow. It cannot be hurried or arranged. It comes to a person the way spring comes, on no schedule, and everyone recognises it once it has.

Then the fruit falls back to the ground. The ones it has happened to come down off the height and become entirely ordinary, even a little odd, seeming weak or cross on purpose so as to stay close to people rather than be set above them. The last modesty is letting someone believe you are flawed, for their sake. The holiest people are the gardeners, hands in the earth, who know that everything comes at its own time and that all of it flowers in the end.
fields.human_design: Extremes Gate 15 is the pressure to live by your own rhythm, and the rhythm swings: long stretches of slow, then a run of fast, weeks of company, then the need to be alone, wide arcs that never settle into the tidy daily habit the world calls discipline. Rather than balance, it is a taste for the whole width of life, the extremes of weather and of people, with a love for all of it, the drab included. From outside it reads as inconsistency, nothing followed through, and the misreading is exactly backwards. Forced into a timetable the rhythm jams, and you end up judging yourself for not keeping hours that were never yours. What goes wrong from inside is the swing between giving everything away and keeping everything back. A whole life with this teaches you to set the edges of a stretch of work, go all in while it is on, rest fully when it is off, and share from the heart without becoming the one who is always emptied.
fields.tarot: This code is the main stem of the Ring of Seeking, the family that carries the long human pressure to reach for more. Its kin, UL 39, 52, 53, 54, and 58, each ignite a different version of that pressure, one seeking rest, one seeking to rise, one seeking the next rung. This code is where all that seeking is meant to finally burn out and bloom. The Hermit reaches this card by two roads at once. Its codon ring carries the Hermit, the one who climbs the mountain alone for the inner light. The two trigrams give their own faces: Earth above as the Devil and the World, the bondage of the dull middle and the completion on the far side of it; Mountain below as the Hierophant and the Hermit again, the one who keeps the tradition low and the one who seeks the height in solitude. What the set leaves open is whether the retreat up the mountain is a hiding place or a height.
fields.body:
The liver is where your body keeps this energy, and the reason is the level it holds. After a meal it takes in what the blood does not need yet and puts it away; between meals it lets it out a little at a time, so the blood holds one level whether you ate an hour ago or ten. It stores your blood as well, and lets it out where you need it. This energy does the same work: taking in where there is too much, paying out where there is too little, so that you can swing between extremes with something steady underneath.

The last time you went half a day without food, nothing in you stopped. That was the liver, paying out what it had put by for you, a little at a time. It is the largest organ inside you, it does the most, and you cannot feel it work. It sits under your right ribs, out of sight, holding your level without a word. The pressure to seek has a substance in you, and the substance is serine. Every part of you is built from twenty pieces, and this is one of them, made in you from what you are already burning, so it never has to be fed. The same substance is in the kin of this energy, and each of them lights a different pressure in you, a thing that begs to be settled; this is the one in which the pressure to seek is finally brought to an end.

Your struggles are written into this chemistry, so are the times you were lifted off the ground, and all of it has run on something you made yourself, out of what you were already burning. The seeking in you burns itself out in the end. You will never feel serine being made; nothing on your plate is needed for it.

fields.essence: Enthusiasm is this energy, the surge of life that gets a thing out of your head and into the world. It is the feeling of being awake in your own life, of caring what happens, so that the day is one you got up for rather than one you got through. It lives in your talent, in whatever you do so well that you forget the time, and it is made to be shared. Where it is missing nothing is wrong, and nothing moves.
fields.glance:
Enthusiasm is this energy, the surge of life that gets a thing out of your head and into the world. It is the feeling of being awake in your own life, of caring what happens, so that the day is one you got up for rather than one you got through. It lives in your talent, in whatever you do so well that you forget the time, and it is made to be shared. Where it is missing nothing is wrong, and nothing moves.

Enthusiasm begins before it feels ready. You start on the thing you keep saying you will start when there is more time, and it turns out that you learn as you go, which is the only way anyone ever learned. Two things happen the moment you begin. A surge of energy comes up from your own excitement, more than you had a minute before, and you stop bending your path to please the people around you. Nobody is coming to help you begin; that part is done alone, and it is the part that costs. Once you are moving you are all there, a whole person standing in the room.

The caring has to be kept alive, because the flat days come. There are stretches when nothing seems worth getting up for, and it feels like tiredness, though it is fear: the fear that if you open your heart to a life you will be drowned in it. It will not drown you. A heart cannot be overwhelmed; it opens further to take the change in. Far from draining you, waking up floods you with purpose. Begin with the thing you actually enjoy, and let it carry you the rest of the way.
fields.iching:
You are at the point where something in you is ready to move, and the whole field can feel it. The thunder that breaks out of the ground in spring does not push; it has been gathering under the surface all winter, and when its time comes everything wakes at once. That is the strength you have now, a readiness that moves other people without your having to argue for it. It is the time for setting helpers in place and setting out with them, because what you begin now people will follow gladly.

It asks you to prepare, then to go. Think beforehand, lay in what you need, study the mark before you let the arrow go; the readiness is in the preparation, and the joy comes after it. Then do not hesitate, because a strength like this spoils if it is held. Move with the time as the sun and the moon do, neither early nor late, so nothing in you strays. The danger is on the far side of the joy: enthusiasm slides into indolence, and what was gathered for the start is spent on the pleasure of having started.

Your foot is where the body feels this. Notice where your weight is now, and whether you are ready to stand. A start is felt there first, in the foot that has already turned toward the door. Hold yourself the way thunder holds inside the earth, gathered and quiet, with everything in you pointed at the moment it moves. Thunder over Earth: the first thunder of spring breaking up out of the ground, with the whole field lying quiet under it a moment before. What was stored below comes up as sound and shakes everything awake. The old character shows a child beside an elephant, careful, reverent, strong; the word means to prepare beforehand, to be ready, at ease, and from there, joy. Enthusiasm
fields.gene_keys:
Indifference Versatility Mastery Care about one thing enough to be absorbed in it and this energy opens the whole world. You pick up the instrument at last and give it years. It takes about seven for a skill to be written into the body so deeply that the hands know it without you; on the far side of those years the skill has become a talent, which is a skill you no longer have to think about. Then the strange thing happens. Having learned one thing all the way through, you find you can learn anything, because the same pattern runs under every art and every science; what you learned was the pattern. The discipline that looked impossible from outside turns out to be easy once the heart is warm.

This is the polymath's energy, the one who moves between painting and business with the same ease, using whatever skill the moment needs, wasting nothing. It runs on enthusiasm, the plain feeling of doing something thoroughly enjoyable that also makes other people's lives better. It can see a child's talent early and put it where it will grow. Not caring is where this energy goes when it is afraid, and it does not feel like fear. It feels like nothing much: a life lived inside the comfortable part of it, the emails and the job, with the attention on what does not matter so it never rests on what does. You are full of plans. The book or the business you keep meaning to start stays on the table, because nothing in you feels strongly enough to move it, and the dream goes on assuming it will happen by itself. The excuse is time, and it was never about time.

The instrument you were given sits in the corner. It is the thing you were born good at, and you have not touched it in years, because touching it means being different from everyone around you who is not bothering either. There is safety in numbers and nothing else in them. A bright, competent life can be built out of skills and systems while it stays untouched; that is what an expert is. What ends this is not a better plan. It is one real experience, actually had, and the caring comes back with it. Living well is the whole of it, and it has nothing to do with skill any more. The heart, which opened, closed, then opened again for years, stops needing to close. The person it happens to is ordinary: cheerful without pretending, giving because they want to, passing unnoticed in every room they light up. They may not be rich, and you can see that they are prospering. There are no more levels. The greatest player can still improve; here the improving is over, because the one who played has gone and left the playing.

Every piece ever written for the piano is already in the body of everyone alive, and from here it could be played by someone who has never touched the keys. The word enthusiasm once meant to be filled with the breath of God. Here it means God is at play, and nobody can stay indifferent to that.
fields.human_design:
Zest Leaping at a new thing and getting good at it is the pressure this energy puts on the body. It enters at Gate 16: the zest that says yes before the details are in, the love of learning that dives to the bottom of a subject, the wish to share what you can do. It is the drive to master a skill, and it masters by repetition, the way an instrument is learned, one pattern played a thousand times until it is yours. From outside the leaping can look unreliable, someone off on an adventure with no map and no food.

The cost runs two ways. One is never sharing the skill, because it is not perfect yet and you are not ready, which can keep a talent in the drawer for years. The other is having been burned by a leap that went wrong, until the zest itself feels dangerous and every risk is refused. What the years teach is that enthusiasm needs a vessel: pack the bag, then jump, because the preparation was never the enemy of the leap.
fields.tarot: Within the Ring of Prosperity, this code is the talent that serves the whole. It shares the ring with only one other, UL 45, the gathering that draws the tribe together. Two cards, one chemistry. The genius that excels and the synergy that pools many gifts into one prospering body. This is a small ring with a large promise: true wealth is people following their genius while working together. The World arrives twice over, by two different roads. The codon ring gives one Arcana, the World, completion and the body fully arrived. The two trigrams give their own faces: Thunder above as the Tower and Judgement, the shock that breaks open and the call that wakes the dead; Earth below as the Devil and the World, the weight that holds you down and the achievement that comes when you carry it consciously. What the five add up to is a breaking and a waking that finally lands in form.
fields.body:
The parathyroid holds this energy in the body, and the reason is the store. These are four glands the size of grains of rice, tucked behind the thyroid, lighter together than a paperclip, and nothing in you moves without them. Every muscle that closes, every beat of your heart, is made on calcium, and these four keep the supply in your blood steady. When a meal falls short they draw on a store you laid down over years, your bones, and when it is full the bones are rebuilt. The move that comes easily in you is coming out of years, and the day nothing moves is the day nothing is drawn.

You cannot feel them, only find the place: the notch at the top of your breastbone, then a thumb's width above it, either side of the windpipe. Now close your hand into a fist. Every muscle that just closed did so on calcium those four grains keep level, out of a store laid down all your life. Zest has a chemistry in you, and the substance is cysteine. Your body makes this one for itself, though only out of a piece it has to be fed: made at home, from what came in from outside. It is one of two pieces in you that carry sulphur, which you smell when hair burns. It is the same with the one thing you do better than anything else: it is made in you out of what you were given, and finding it costs the risk of being different from everyone who is not bothering.

A body that stops spending itself on what does not matter has that much more for the one thing, and the further into your talent you go, the more the world comes to meet you halfway. Strike out alone and the right people find you, some carrying this same substance.

fields.essence: This energy is the one that sees ahead, the part of the mind that reads where a thing is going before it gets there. It watches one thing turn into the next, then the next, and from the shape of that it knows what is coming, the way you know rain from the colour of the sky an hour before it falls. It lives in the sorting mind, the part that compares things and finds the flaw. It is the instrument you were given for telling what is true.
fields.glance:
This energy is the one that sees ahead, the part of the mind that reads where a thing is going before it gets there. It watches one thing turn into the next, then the next, and from the shape of that it knows what is coming, the way you know rain from the colour of the sky an hour before it falls. It lives in the sorting mind, the part that compares things and finds the flaw. It is the instrument you were given for telling what is true.

Foresight is held lightly. What you see is a possibility until the thing has happened, so you go on looking after you have seen, and you let the view change when what you are looking at changes. Much of the time you will be early. What is plain to you now, others will see in twenty years, and the waiting is part of the work, so you learn to keep what you saw without needing anyone to agree with it yet.

Keep looking, and speak only when you are asked. The mind wants one fixed thing to hold so that fear stays still, and a view decided young then defended ever since is that thing. It is not sight. It is the one thing that stops sight. Let what you see be the answer to a question, never the interruption, because the seeing is the same either way and only the timing decides what it does.
fields.iching:
You are following, or you are followed, and the two are one situation seen from either end. One thing comes after another. The strong one has put himself under the rest, not over them, and because he is under them they move with him without being told. That is the whole art: whoever wants to lead learns first to go behind. Press people and they pull away. Serve them and they come, then stay. What is asked of you is to see what you are following. Following is neither weak nor strong in itself; it is only as good as what stands at the other end of it. Behind what is true, it goes right through. Behind what is nearest, or loudest, it turns on you. To get, first give; walk behind someone long enough and they will find they are walking behind you. The time itself is what to follow: rise when it rises, go in when it goes down. At nightfall the thunder goes under the water; the one who does this well goes indoors too, eats, rests, with nothing left to prove until morning.

In the body this energy is the foot. Notice where your weight is now: on the step ahead, or on the one you are standing on. Let the foot fall where the ground goes, one step after the last, and keep to what is true while it does. Lake over Thunder: open water lying still, and under it the first stir of the year, the force that wakes what was buried. Thunder is the sun coming up in the east, and the lake is the sun going down in the west. Thunder inside the lake is evening, the stir gone in under the water, with morning sure to come after it. One thing follows another, in order. Following
fields.gene_keys:
Opinion Far-Sightedness Omniscience Both eyes open, the world has depth again, and this seeing can begin. You take in the small workings of a thing along with the whole of it, so you can watch one pattern give birth to the next, and from that you see a little way into what is coming. The seeing is not cold. It comes through the heart before it reaches the head. Nor is it idle; it has work, which is to call out what is being misrepresented, because you can see an argument built on one side with the other side hidden. You know opinion from the inside, so when you meet it in someone else you do not fight it, or try to turn them, since that cannot be done. Doubt your own doubt as freely as anyone else's, and you will have nothing left to defend.

At first the view comes and goes. It arrives like a contraction, a moment when the whole is clear, then ordinary sight again, and the plain time between is where what you saw gets taken in. You are given that time so what you saw can settle into an ordinary day. Somewhere young you took a side, and you have been finding proof for it ever since. You have two eyes so that the world has depth. Close one and everything goes flat; an opinion is one eye closed. The seed was planted in your first seven years, before you had words. It came up in your teens, when the mind went looking for something solid and took whatever was nearest. The mind that does this is the sorting mind, the part that compares, ranks, finds the flaw, and there is nothing wrong with it. The trouble starts when a flaw it found becomes the ground a whole view is built on, and a molehill is a mountain by the time you are grown.

A view held this way has to be defended, and the moment you are defending it you have stopped looking. It was never about the subject, which is why it hardens when it is pushed. Take anything that troubles you and see whether there is a should inside it; that should is the first refusal of what is. Then notice that the view could change by tomorrow, which is how you know it was never you. Nothing is left of the mind but one eye, and the seeing pours through it in every direction at once. The one who looked and the thing looked at have fallen into each other, so there are no longer two sides to stand between. This is the only part of the mind that survives the opening of the heart. The true seer is blind, because at this height you are not the one seeing: you are seen through.

It comes suddenly, like lightning, and it acts as it sees. A falcon sits hooded on the glove, dozing. The hood comes off, it is wholly awake, and from the eye finding its mark to the drop there is no gap. Seeing like that, turned not to hunting but to showing, ends the old fighting. Nothing needs doing. Whatever you decide is already in step with the whole, and it only comes once nobody is home.
fields.human_design:
Anticipation Here the pressure is to run the mind ahead. Gate 17 is the door it comes through: the drive to take what has happened before, find the pattern in it, and follow the pattern forward to what could be, further than most people think is possible. It is there to make order, and from inside it feels like a view on everything, arriving whether or not anyone asked.

That is where it goes wrong. The same pressure that produces the seeing produces the urge to say it now, and said before it was wanted, the view that could have opened a room closes it instead. Then it is read as the know-it-all. From outside the fault looks like arrogance. From inside it is a door that opens and cannot wait. The other habit that grows on it is doubt for its own sake, suspicion worn as intelligence, until the mind that was built to see what could be sees only what could go wrong. People who carry this all their lives learn that the seeing was never the hard part, and that the hard part is holding it until the room asks.
fields.tarot: Within the Ring of Humanity, this code carries the seeing. Its siblings, UL 10, 21, 25, 38, and 51, hold the rest of what makes us human: the way we move through life, the bite that controls, the innocence, the fighter, the shock that wakes. The old teaching says this ring holds the blueprint of where our species is going, and that most of what it carries comes back, in the end, to the authority of the heart. Five arcana stand behind this card. The codon ring gives one, the Chariot, the will that holds a course. The two trigrams each give their own faces: Lake above as the Lovers and the Star, the choosing and the hope that heals; Thunder below as the Tower and Judgement, the shock that breaks open and the call that wakes the dead. Ask whether the course you chose holds when the Tower arrives, or whether you were only ever following the loudest voice in the room.
fields.body:
The pituitary carries this energy, and the eyes are the reason. The gland hangs under your brain, in the middle of your head. The nerves from your two eyes cross directly above it, so everything you look at passes over it on its way to becoming sight. It does none of your seeing itself. Nearly everything it sends out is a message, to the gland in your neck that sets your pace or the ones over your kidneys that rouse you, and the rest of you does the doing. That is what seeing ahead is in you: a small thing that reads and sends word, then waits for you to move.

It is about the size of a pea, and how tall you grew was decided by it, year by year, in what it released while you slept. Close your eyes, put a fingertip to the bridge of your nose: the crossing is straight back from there, deep in the head, and the gland hangs just beneath it, under everything you have ever looked at. The seeing you carry has a substance in you, and the substance is arginine. It is one of the twenty small pieces everything in you is built from, and it is written into you six ways, more ways than almost any other piece. Your body makes some of it, and the rest comes in from meat or a handful of nuts. What people are still to become is folded into you there, with what you already are.

What sees ahead in you comes from the heart before the head, and in the body the two share one chemistry. There is nothing here for you to put a hand on. It is only that the eye that reads what is coming was written into you before you first opened the other two.

fields.essence: Putting things right is the energy you carry: a sense for what has gone wrong, built into you as deep as anything is, and the drive to mend it. You see the flaw before a word is said, in a face across a table or in a piece of work. Judging is how a mind thinks, so there is no stopping it, and nobody ever has. It lives wherever something has been let slide, and it makes you the one who noticed.
fields.glance:
Putting things right is the energy you carry: a sense for what has gone wrong, built into you as deep as anything is, and the drive to mend it. You see the flaw before a word is said, in a face across a table or in a piece of work. Judging is how a mind thinks, so there is no stopping it, and nobody ever has. It lives wherever something has been let slide, and it makes you the one who noticed.

The sense can be carried by two hearts, and the flaw looks the same from both. From a closed heart what is wrong is a curse you carry into every room, with nothing to be done about it but suffer it. From an open one the same flaw is the reason to do something, and people call that wisdom. Make a judgement knowing, as you make it, that you are making one, and from then on it does not have you. An opinion held lightly needs no defending. The question that settles most of it is whether you would rather be right or happy.

The work begins in your own thinking. The verdicts you carry were mostly handed to you young, and clearing them out is what gives you back a clear head. Only then is the eye fit to turn outward. There are seasons when everything you look at seems wrong, and the tightness of that is felt by the people near you before they have heard a word. What you cannot stand out there is showing you something of your own that is asking to be settled. Mend that first. You were never asked to make the world perfect, only to work on what was spoiled.
fields.iching:
Something has reached you already spoiled. It was going wrong before it was yours, in a house or a piece of work that somebody before you stopped tending, and now it is in your hands. The rot is not your doing. The mending is. That is the whole of the situation, and the old text calls it a good one: a thing that has gone bad can be worked on, so the working brings it through to growth.

What it asks is that you stir the air. Where nothing moves, everything spoils, so the counsel is to rouse whatever has gone still, in yourself as much as in the people round you, the way wind carries seed up a slope until bare ground greens again.
